job.job_description:
About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full-Stack Developer with 4-6 years of experience to lead and scale our core product offerings. In this role, you will design and implement modern web applications end-to-end, blending robust frontend interfaces with high-performance backend microservices and modern Generative AI / Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.

You will take ownership of system architecture, API performance, database optimization, and cloud deployment pipelines while helping integrate production-grade LLM workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Engineering:
Architectural design and implementation of modern, responsive frontend applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and state management tools (Redux / React Query).
Build reusable component libraries and design systems to ensure consistent UI patterns and rapid feature deployment.
Optimize web performance (Lighthouse scores, code-splitting, lazy loading, state memoization) for high-data dashboards.
Backend Engineering & Data:
Design, build, and deploy scalable microservices and RESTful APIs using Python (FastAPI / Django) and Node.js (Express / NestJS).
Design, query, and optimize relational databases using SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL) and caching platforms (Redis).
Implement event-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, BullMQ, or RabbitMQ) for real-time event streaming and data processing.
GenAI & RAG Engineering:
Integrate LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) into core workflows with prompt engineering, prompt batching, and response caching to control API costs and latency.
Build and optimize RAG systems leveraging vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, PGVector, Qdrant) and document ingestion/chunking pipelines (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Cloud & DevOps:
Deploy, manage, and scale applications on AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudFront).
Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerize applications using Docker, and enforce production-level security standard (RBAC, OAuth 2.0).

Qualifications & Key Requirements

Experience: 46 years of software engineering experience in full-stack web application development and production deployments.
Frontend: Strong expertise in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, and WebSockets.
Backend: Proficiency in Python and Node.js (Express/NestJS) for building scalable microservices and async data processing.
Database & Caching: Strong competency in SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL), query optimization, indexing, and Redis caching mechanisms.
GenAI & AI Integrations: Direct experience building Generative AI features, LLM API integrations, and RAG frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Search).
Cloud Infrastructure: Solid hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and containerization tools like Docker.
Architecture: Practical understanding of event-driven design, RBAC, multi-tenant database isolation, and API security protocols.
